modules/hr/helpdesk/employee-support.con: uses only self:support; employee self-service is platform-core and never carries @RequireModule per CLAUDE.md §8
modules/hr/hub/manager-home.controller.t: single @Universal() handler serving the caller's own team view; universal surfaces are not product-gated
modules/hr/performance/self-document-ack: uses only self:document-acknowledgements; employee self-service is platform-core and never carries @RequireModule per CLAUDE.md §8

modules/payroll/insights/ess-form16.cont: uses only self:payslips; an employee's own Form 16 is self-service, platform-core and never carries @RequireModule per CLAUDE.md §8
modules/payroll/insights/payroll-ai-expl: uses only self:payslips; employee self-service is platform-core and never carries @RequireModule per CLAUDE.md §8
